title: Design a reversible observe-only (pass-through) Engram control mode: ordinary turns are not withheld by control admission (Greg 2026-10-11)
outcome: A concrete, reversible design, delivered to Engram::Advisor for Greg's decision, for running the Engram control plane in an observe-only/pass-through mode. Ordinary coding turns are never withheld by control admission (no evaluate/begin/checkpoint wait on the turn's critical path), while diagnostics and verification evidence are retained (observations, checks, source revisions and so on, recorded asynchronously or best-effort). The design: (1) lists every place the host blocks a turn on control today (admission, begin, checkpoint, bind, recovery holds), with file:line; (2) identifies the narrow cases, if any, that genuinely need hard blocking, each with its justification; (3) defines the feature/config boundary for switching modes (per session, per project or host-wide), its default, and how to switch back; (4) states what evidence and guarantees are lost or weakened in observe-only mode, and what Engram's acceptance/verification still gets; (5) gives the migration and validation scope: tests, a live proof, a restart, and Engram-side changes if any. No global runtime configuration is changed by this item. The P1 transient repairs continue only as safety until the decision.
acceptance: Design a reversible observe-only (pass-through) Engram control mode: ordinary turns are not withheld by control admission (Greg 2026-10-11) is done
